characters.description: An Arbitage professor and rune researcher who leads Moxie and Lee's group. He enters Moxie's soul to reconstruct her flawed runes, even after Azel manifests there and adds a dangerous complication.
characters.name: Vermil

characters.description: An Arbitage magus whose soul takes the form of a forest. She trusts Vermil to dismantle and rebuild the flawed vine and flower runes that limit her growth.
characters.name: Moxie

characters.description: Vermil's demon companion and a member of his close-knit group. She supports the effort to repair Moxie's runes.
characters.name: Lee

characters.description: A rank-five demon bound to Vermil's soul. He can manifest independently when Vermil enters another soul space, and his intrusion into Moxie's forest makes an already delicate repair far more dangerous.
characters.name: Azel

characters.description: A Linwick shapeshifter and Vermil's unwanted arranged fiancee. She seeks temporary shelter from danger connected to her family, and Vermil asks her to obtain high-quality catch paper.
characters.name: Karina

characters.description: A silver-limbed mage who has encountered Vermil before. He arrives seeking a private conversation with him.
characters.name: Silvertide

characters.description: One of Vermil's Arbitage students. He accepts Silvertide's offer of two months of vacation training while remaining Vermil's student.
characters.name: Todd

characters.description: One of Vermil's Arbitage students and Todd's training partner. She accepts Silvertide's offer of intensive vacation instruction while remaining committed to Vermil as her professor.
characters.name: Isabel

characters.description: An unidentified spined, rune-marked creature that appears on Vermil's chest and later watches from beside his gourd. Its nature, intentions, and connection to him are unknown.
characters.name: catlike entity

characters.description: The name given to the horned red cat that has repeatedly appeared near Vermil's group. It is connected to the Fragment of Renewal and has consistently drawn manageable monsters toward the group, though its origin and purpose remain unknown.
characters.name: Mascot

characters.description: A Dawnforge merchant known to Moxie and considered relatively honest by local standards. He evaluates the group's monster materials and takes a particular interest in their more unusual finds.
characters.name: Thaddeus

characters.description: The man occupying Vermil's body. He tells Moxie that he came from a nonmagical Earth and was once a violin performer and teacher. Vermil died before Noah arrived, and Moxie accepts Noah's account of his identity.
characters.name: Noah Vines

characters.description: An oath-bound Dawnforge craftsperson who once made Evergreen's staff. He lost both hands afterward, and Moxie offers payment and proposes acting as his hands if he accepts a private violin commission.
characters.name: Arnold

characters.description: A sword-carrying rune user who pursues criminals while concealing his presence, even from Lee's sense of smell. He meets Lee while chasing an armed fugitive through Dawnforge.
characters.name: Tillian

characters.description: A Dawnforge imbuer, shopkeeper, clothing-maker, and painter. Olive sells the group a flying sword and offers Lee favorable terms on a battle axe in exchange for modeling for a painting.
characters.name: Olive

characters.description: A hired assassin with tracking skill who pursues Lee alongside an unnamed partner. He waits for an opening because she is traveling with Vermil and Moxie.
characters.name: Zale

characters.description: A violent Dawnforge magus responding to a failed operation against Vermil's group. He hides ruthless punishment behind a mild manner and kills the subordinate whose poor information compromised the attack.
characters.name: Gentil

characters.description: A rank-three stealth assassin serving Gentil. He uses daggers and concealed movement to stall Vermil's group inside the criminal base.
characters.name: Stigman

characters.description: A heavily armored lightning fighter and the brother of a defender killed by Vermil's group. His armor absorbs lightning and converts it into power for an electric sword.
characters.name: Bryorn

characters.description: Gentil's associate and the unseen figure specifically interested in taking Moxie. His reasons and precise place in the wider Dawnforge operation are not yet known.
characters.name: Wizen

characters.description: The figure directing Vermil's Linwick branch. He permits Gentil to kill Vermil, yet privately anticipates Gentil's failure and prepares to exploit the result.
characters.name: apparent Father

characters.description: The Linwick figure whom the Records of the Deceased lists as dead. This conflicts with the continuing presence of the figure treated as Father and leaves their relationship unresolved.
characters.name: Father Linwick

characters.description: Gentil's young sword-wielding assistant. Gentil orders her to fight Noah's group while leaving Moxie alive.
characters.name: Alexandra

characters.description: A messenger and analyst serving the apparent Father. After Gentil's death, she delivers a black-flower warning and a sealed letter intended for Wizen.
characters.name: Janice

characters.description: A Linwick mage who arrives during the group's hunt and destroys a building-sized stone spider. He warns that the apparent Father is acting more openly than usual and approaches Vermil as an uneasy family connection.
characters.name: Brayden

characters.description: A powerful Arbalest Empire enforcer who shadows Ferdinand. She is strong enough to kill him, but limits herself to monitoring and threats while he remains within the rules.
characters.name: Garina

characters.description: A rank-six operative of the Church of Repose. He conceals the target of a goddess-directed mission from Garina, whose surveillance prevents him from pursuing the search freely.
characters.name: Ferdinand

characters.description: The young Torrin heir taught by Moxie. Her resistance to Evergreen's influence is cited as the reason Evergreen abruptly recalls Moxie.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: A Torrin side-branch messenger sent to recall Moxie. Fearful of the consequences for them both, she delays delivering Evergreen's order before explaining the danger behind it.
characters.name: Contessa

characters.description: A rank-six Torrin authority who controls Moxie's employment and the runes supplied by the family. Her recall order carries lethal force through Moxie's rune oaths.
characters.name: Magus Evergreen

characters.description: A near-rank-six Torrin main-branch leader who has reportedly waited years for a chance to overthrow Evergreen. Lee brings her a warning designed to make an approaching confrontation look like that opportunity.
characters.name: Rinella

characters.description: The captain of the Torrin city guard. He demands corroboration before mobilizing his forces in response to Vermil's report of a supposed coup against Evergreen.
characters.name: Edan

characters.description: A Torrin guard captain who arrives after Evergreen's death. He refuses to accept Rinella's attempt to blame Vermil and begins treating the incident as part of a broader corruption case.
characters.name: Idan

characters.description: The magus who destroyed Magus Evergreen's hijacked construct before its controller could be investigated further.
characters.name: Revin

characters.description: Revin's trainee. She receives his report about the upheaval among the Torrins and remains under his instruction.
characters.name: Eline

characters.description: A rank-six Linwick magus who oversees the family catacombs. After restoring the collapsed site, he discovers that a dangerous ledger and a hungry catch-paper book have both been stolen and begins investigating the intruder.
characters.name: Jalen

recaps.ending: Noah, Moxie, and Lee remain together after leaving the Linwick catacombs. Moxie is free of Torrin oaths and has rebuilt three genuinely perfect rank-three runes. Lee has a stronger demon-compatible set but still requires additional repairs, while Noah concludes that Natural Disaster is too broad and unstable for safe advancement in its current form. Noah's new grimoire has consumed his former grimoire, stored runes, Dayton's scroll, and the Records of the Deceased, preserving the ledger's information while becoming hungry and partly responsive. That information records Father Linwick as dead, leaving the identity of the apparent Father unresolved. Near Dawnforge, the group learns that the great monster's enormous sand-armored snake is a construct hiding its true body. Noah dies during the first test, revives, and prepares a formation-assisted second attack. Elsewhere, Jalen identifies Karina as the route to Vermil. He gives her a functional magical replacement foot, then threatens her life unless she independently persuades Vermil to meet him with the stolen grimoire. Noah does not yet know that Karina is being forced toward him. Wizen, Azel, the Heron threat, the Church of Repose mission, and the apparent Father's identity all remain open.
recaps.in_short: Noah repairs Moxie's runes, reveals his true identity to her and begins a relationship with her, while their summer work in Dawnforge draws them into Gentil's criminal network. They kill Gentil and free Alexandra, but Wizen remains at large. Evergreen then recalls Moxie under threat of execution. Noah, Moxie, Lee, Azel and rival Torrin factions engineer Evergreen's defeat, after which Moxie's family runes are broken and her oaths finally end. The group discovers that inherited rune designs can hide serious imbalance and develops a method for making genuinely perfect runes. Karina guides them into the Linwick catacombs, where Noah learns that Father Linwick is recorded as dead and gains a hungry, semi-sapient grimoire. The group then identifies a great monster's huge snake body as a sand construct and prepares a rematch. Meanwhile, Jalen traces the catacomb theft to Karina and coerces her into bringing Vermil and the stolen grimoire to him.

recaps.text: Previously: Noah Vines died on Earth and eventually entered the dead body of the Arbitage professor Vermil. Publicly living under Vermil's identity, he developed an unusual ability to separate, combine, and improve runes through Sunder. He became closely tied to Moxie, Lee, and his students Todd and Isabel, while concealing his origin from nearly everyone around him. Azel, a powerful demon, remains bound within Noah's soul and cannot be treated as a trustworthy ally. Moxie is constrained by the Torrin family, which supplied some of her runes and controls her position as Emily's teacher. Lee is a demon whose damaged rune set limits her growth. Todd and Isabel have reached rank two, but Todd carries a severe neck injury and Isabel possesses an inherited Master Rune that may draw hostile attention. Noah also remains entangled with the Linwick family through Vermil's body, an arranged engagement to the shapeshifter Karina, and the figure treated as Father. The group begins this volume with hard-won trust, dangerous family obligations, and a shared interest in rebuilding flawed runes.

Vermil enters Moxie's soul and uses Sunder to dismantle her flawed rank-three runes. Azel intrudes through their bond and privately pressures Moxie into promising three personal answers, but the repair succeeds: Moxie emerges with seven perfect runes at roughly half charge. Lee cannot begin the same process because the group lacks both replacement material and suitable catch paper. Karina, the Linwick shapeshifter previously known as Bria, asks for shelter and offers access to an effectively limitless grimoire in the family catacombs if Vermil can free her from their arranged engagement. Silvertide then questions Vermil about the Hellreaver's death. Accepting his account, Silvertide takes Todd and Isabel for two months of vacation training, offers to investigate Todd's neck injury, and identifies a Heron-family mind-rune user as the likely saboteur who pursued Isabel's Master Rune. Vermil, Moxie, and Lee decide to spend the break adventuring for money, runes, and practical training. An unexplained rune-marked catlike creature begins appearing near Vermil. With one month before Karina's rendezvous, the trio travels to the monster-rich city of Dawnforge and prepares to hunt outside its walls.

A hidden force pulls Vermil and Moxie into a corrupted underground cavern near Dawnforge. They escape, but the creature below survives, and a similarly corrupted bird attacks Lee. The recurring catlike presence appears connected to these encounters, though the group cannot tell whether it is helping or hunting them. After killing an ice-armored monster, Vermil harvests its runes and rebuilds Natural Disaster around a new perfect Freezing Blizzard component. The altered rune is smoother and appears improved. In Dawnforge, Moxie negotiates the sale of their monster materials through Thaddeus and rents the group a room. Vermil then opens Revin's formation primer and discovers that its basic formations use musical notation. This leads him to disclose a guarded part of his past to Moxie. His real name is Noah Vines. He came from a nonmagical Earth, where violin performance and teaching defined his life, and he spent what felt like millennia in an afterlife before occupying Vermil's body after Vermil had died. Moxie accepts that Noah is neither Vermil nor a disguised demon. Noah decides to obtain a violin and eventually tell Lee the truth as well.

Moxie secretly commissions Arnold, an injured but highly skilled Dawnforge craftsperson, to make Noah a travel-ready seven-string violin. Her effort and intent create concealed beneficial imbuements, and the instrument bonds permanently to Noah. The gift brings Noah and Moxie closer, and they agree to begin a romantic relationship despite the dangers surrounding them. Lee meets Tillian, a concealed rune user hunting criminals, and the group takes paid monster jobs while continuing to look for runes suitable for Lee. Olive supplies a flying sword and trades Lee a battle axe for modeling work. Unknown to the group, Zale and another assassin begin tracking Lee, while Gentil learns that the attackers were given dangerously incomplete information. Outside Dawnforge, Noah, Moxie, and Lee complete a hunt for oversized claws and test their improved coordination. The horned cat appears again just as Zale and his partner attack. A massive armored burrowing creature erupts from below and crushes both assassins, then turns on Noah's group. The cat vanishes before the charge, preserving the uncertainty over whether it deliberately delivered danger, protection, or both.

Noah, Moxie, and Lee kill the armored burrowing monster and return to Dawnforge, where Lee tracks the assassins' associates to a bakery concealing a criminal base. Their assault reveals a larger operation. Gentil is acting with permission from the figure treated as Father, while an associate named Wizen has a specific, unexplained interest in Moxie. The group fights through Gentil's defenders, killing the stealth fighter Stigman and several stronger opponents before reaching Gentil's chamber. There, Gentil orders Alexandra, a young swordswoman, to remove the intruders while sparing Moxie. Alexandra's brief resistance shows that she is being compelled. Noah shatters Gentil's high-rank protective bracelet with Sunder and kills him by igniting combustible smoke inside his body. Gentil's death releases Alexandra's body from control. She explains that Wizen installed the imbuement, left her conscious while controlling her actions, and scrambled her memories of him. Moxie spares her and allows her to leave Dawnforge with the group. Gentil's local command is destroyed, but Wizen remains free, his interest in Moxie is still unexplained, and the group carries away an unidentified black dagger found among Gentil's concealed valuables.

Noah returns in a replacement body after the fatal method he used against Gentil, retaining both his body imbuements and his bond to the violin. Lee designs a future rune set around shadow, shifting, matter, and space, but the price of a suitable space rune is far beyond the group's means. Brayden arrives during a monster hunt and warns that the apparent Father is making unusually active moves. Noah tells him the truth: Vermil died from Father's poison before Noah occupied the body. Brayden keeps the secret, later distinguishing his grief for Vermil from the possibility of becoming Noah's friend, and sends a space rune for Lee. Azel admits that he has been reopening emotions sealed inside Noah and that he feeds only on genuine feelings. Noah still refuses to regard him as an ally. The horned cat demonstrates that it understands writing and repeatedly brings useful encounters, leading Noah to treat it as provisionally helpful. The group prepares to hunt a nearby great monster, while Garina's surveillance continues to obstruct Ferdinand's undisclosed Church of Repose mission. Before the hunt begins, Contessa arrives with Evergreen's recall order for Moxie. Because Evergreen controls Torrin-supplied runes and oaths, Moxie understands the summons as an execution threat. Noah refuses to let her face it alone.

The apparent Father refuses to save Moxie unless Noah swears fealty, so Noah, Moxie, and Lee devise their own plan during the journey to the Torrin city. They rebuild Lee's runes with shadow, space, and a demon rune supplied by Azel, then use layered deceptions to turn Evergreen's enemies against her. Lee convinces Rinella that an apparent archdemon will leave Evergreen vulnerable. Noah gives the guard captain Edan a false warning of a coup, mobilizing the city guard, while Azel and Noah confront Evergreen directly. Evergreen overwhelms Azel and kills Noah twice as he struggles to complete a violin formation. Noah finally substitutes the Fragment of Renewal's decay for Sunder in the formation, weakening Evergreen's armor enough for Rinella to strike. Rinella kills Evergreen and tries to frame Noah and Moxie, but Evergreen badly injures her first, and Idan kills Rinella when she resists arrest. After a corruption investigation, Edan releases Noah and Moxie. Torrin leaders end Moxie's sponsorship of Emily and order the family-provided runes inside her destroyed. The punishment leaves Moxie two runes short, but it also breaks the oaths tied to them. She departs the city injured yet finally free of Evergreen and direct Torrin control.

Leaving the Torrin city, Noah, Moxie, and Lee discover that runes which appear perfect at rest can become unbalanced when particular aspects are used. The flaw appears in inherited family designs and may help explain why advancement to rank seven is so rare. Noah tests Natural Disaster and concludes that its many competing concepts make it too broad for stable use at rank three. He begins favoring narrower, purpose-built disaster runes instead. The horned cat continues delivering manageable monsters and is formally named Mascot, though its nature remains unknown. Noah's first improvised formation using Natural Disaster fails because the music does not contain all of the rune's aspects, and the resulting wind kills him before Sunder restores him. The group reaches the mountain village where Karina is waiting and learns that she lost a foot while attempting the Linwick catacombs alone. Before entering, Noah and Moxie use a newly purchased mind-meld potion to rebuild her remaining runes around focused, compatible intent. After rejecting several imperfect combinations, Moxie produces three genuinely perfect rank-three runes: Sowed Earth, Sprouting Plant, and Bloodletting Plant. The successful method gives the group a practical foundation for future advancement and for eventually repairing Lee's set.

Lee rejects Azel's attempt to convince her that Noah and Moxie's romance will exclude her, reaffirming that the group is her chosen family. Noah then secures the apparent Father's agreement to end his engagement to Karina. Karina accepts the release and guides Noah, Moxie, and Lee into the Linwick catacombs, where Noah kills a powerful Frost White and she safely disables the target tomb's trap. They recover a massive book-like artifact. Noah also finds the Records of the Deceased, a secret bloodline-locked Linwick ledger. It lists Vermil and Father Linwick as dead while listing Brayden as alive, suggesting that the figure currently acting as Father cannot straightforwardly be the recorded patriarch. Moving the ledger triggers the catacombs' collapse defense, so Noah steals it and escapes while maintaining contact. The original tomb book then awakens, consumes Noah's former grimoire, stored runes, and Dayton's scroll, and becomes a semi-sapient grimoire that responds only to him. Noah negotiates a warning before it consumes stored material. Finally, the hungry grimoire devours the Records of the Deceased, stopping its alarm while reproducing its written information. The ledger is gone as a separate artifact, but its contradiction about Father remains preserved.

Jalen, a rank-six Linwick magus overseeing the catacombs, restores the collapsed site and discovers both the hungry book and the Records of the Deceased missing. He traces the intrusion toward Karina while refusing the apparent Father's attempt to gain influence over his investigation. Meanwhile, Noah, Moxie, and Lee return to the wilderness near Dawnforge. Moxie's newly perfected runes give her markedly stronger control over plants, and the group continues planning tailored rank-three advancement for Todd, Isabel, and Emily. They find the suspected great monster in the form of an enormous sand-armored snake. Noah's attacks reveal that the snake has no flesh inside its shell: it is an earth-and-sand construct protecting a hidden true body. The construct kills him, but he revives and plans a formation-assisted rematch using the Fragment of Renewal while Moxie restrains it. Elsewhere, Jalen intercepts Karina and learns that Vermil took the grimoire. He restores her missing foot with black magic, then makes the gift part of a coercive bargain. Karina must independently persuade Vermil to meet Jalen and bring the stolen book. Jalen threatens to kill her if Vermil dies or fails to come. The book closes with Noah's group preparing for the great-monster rematch while the Linwick threat advances toward them without their knowledge.

characters.description: An Arbitage professor and rune researcher who leads Moxie and Lee in dangerous hunts. He uses violin-driven formations, but needs his companions to defend him while the music takes shape.
characters.name: Noah Vines

characters.description: Noah's partner and fellow Arbitage magus, equally at home teaching and fighting beside him. After helping bring down a great snake monster, she claims the Earth Master Rune Earthen Muster.
characters.name: Moxie

characters.description: Noah and Moxie's demon companion, a formidable fighter whose body can assume unusual forms. She helps hold a great monster at bay while Noah prepares a musical formation.
characters.name: Lee

characters.description: A demon already connected to Noah's group and especially to Lee.
characters.name: Azel

characters.description: One of Noah's students, newly returned from demanding training with Silvertide. Expensive treatment has largely healed his injured neck, allowing him to join the class assessment on Windscorn Plateau.
characters.name: Todd

characters.description: One of Noah's students, visibly stronger after training with Silvertide and ready to join the class assessment on Windscorn Plateau.
characters.name: Isabel

characters.description: A Torrin heir and one of Noah's students. The upheaval following Evergreen's death weighs on the people around her as she prepares to resume training at Arbitage.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: A former captive freed from Gentil's control who comes to Arbitage seeking Noah's instruction.
characters.name: Alexandra

characters.description: Revin's student, temporarily admitted to Noah's lesson at Emily's request. He accompanies the class to Windscorn Plateau for a practical assessment.
characters.name: James

characters.description: The Arbitage operator responsible for launching travelers through the transport cannon. His own runes are damaged, a problem Noah would like to repair without exposing closely guarded abilities.
characters.name: Tim

characters.description: A Linwick shapeshifter and Noah's former arranged fiancee. She returns to Arbitage carrying an urgent order from the Linwick family head for Noah to attend a meeting.
characters.name: Karina

characters.description: Evergreen's former aide, left without work or a home after her employer's death. She seeks shelter with Noah.
characters.name: Contessa

characters.description: An anonymous and apparently wealthy bidder at the noble auction. Through a representative, Number 14 asks Noah's masked group not to compete for Violet Transference and shows interest in an untested monster rune.
characters.name: Number 14

characters.description: The rank-six head of the Linwick family. He orders Karina to bring Noah to the family estate over artifacts taken from the catacombs, with assassins a possible consequence of refusal.
characters.name: Jalen

characters.description: A Linwick assassin sent by Jalen to target Noah under the Vermil identity. He watches Noah at Arbitage but declines a direct strike because he suspects a trap.
characters.name: Aiden

characters.description: A Linwick power broker who knows Wizen and has reasons of his own to oppose him. He offers Noah limited intelligence about the mind mage, but presents himself as a temporary source rather than a trusted ally.
characters.name: Father

characters.description: A Linwick mage whom Father promises to send in support of Noah's efforts against Wizen. His capabilities and the exact form of his assistance have not yet been shown.
characters.name: Brayden

characters.description: The hostile mage behind plant constructs that replace dead people and attack anyone who discovers them. He is holding Evergreen and intends to use her runes in the creation of a stronger form.
characters.name: Wizen

characters.description: A deceased Torrin figure whose former aide is left without work or shelter. Moxie asks that Emily not be told about the control Evergreen once exercised over her.
characters.name: Evergreen

characters.description: A powerful rank-five ally known to Noah's group from earlier events.
characters.name: Silvertide

characters.description: An advanced-track teacher and puppet user who arranged Noah's combat test with a remotely controlled swordsman. After he passes, she offers access to further knowledge if he joins the program.
characters.name: Ulya

characters.description: An advanced-track faculty tester who makes Alexandra's admission depend on a private fight. His domain suppresses her magic and lets ordinary physical attacks pass through him.
characters.name: Gero

characters.description: An advanced-track researcher and imbuer who questions whether Moxie belongs after the loss of her runes. He insists on testing the matter through a fight to exhaustion.
characters.name: Will

characters.description: The senior host of the advanced track's underground welcome gathering. He receives the newcomers while Noah privately detects the alarming absence of a heartbeat.
characters.name: Godric

characters.description: A white-haired advanced-track professor whom Silvertide secretly identifies as the hostile puppet hidden at the gathering. He keeps the discovery quiet so the controlling enemy will not know the deception has failed.
characters.name: Mayreena

characters.description: A rank-five Inquisitor seeking vengeance for two slain subordinates. Using regulated blood magic and a rosary made from demon bones, he establishes a trail toward the demon responsible.
characters.name: Raphael

characters.description: A deity linked to the red-horned cat avatar. She discovers that alterations to its runes have broken her practical control, prompting a new interest in the mortal responsible.
characters.name: Renewal

characters.description: A deity associated with Garina and the severing of power. Decras visits Renewal and compensates her for an earlier shared loss.
characters.name: Decras

characters.description: A red-horned catlike companion that appears without explanation in Noah's room. It calmly bonds with Contessa, who accepts responsibility for its care as part of her new arrangement with Noah.
characters.name: Mascot

characters.description: A powerful searcher pursuing a person sought by a god. She has distributed valuable runes among major cities as bait and attends the noble auction to watch for a response.
characters.name: Garina

characters.description: Garina's traveling companion in the search for a powerful target. He suspects their quarry may be deliberately avoiding the notice of major families.
characters.name: Ferdinand

characters.description: Vermil's masked mentor, presented as a powerful authority on the body-replacement threat. Spider tells Ulya that one clone is present at the advanced-track gathering and recommends leaving it hidden long enough to trace its controller.
characters.name: Spider

characters.description: An advanced-track professor assigned to collect Silvertide. Silvertide discovers that Peter has already been killed and that plant magic is controlling his body.
characters.name: Peter

recaps.ending: Silvertide has destroyed Wizen's local puppets and badly damaged the Evergreen essence in his possession, but Wizen remains active and his objective involving the Torrins is unknown. Jalen agrees only to investigate, while Father remains a self-interested source and Karina's obligations are unresolved. Noah is a rank-four mage with a perfect Natural Disaster rune, a suppressive domain, and a violin that can channel two rune effects at once. Moxie continues rebuilding and teaching, and the students have entered the advanced track with their individual pattern work underway. Raphael is dead after Azel took the Inquisitor's bloodline curse and died from it. Lee has advanced to rank four, but Azel's restraint on her dangerous demon rune is only temporary. Emily accepts Lee without hesitation, Alexandra remains cautious but does not reject her, and Brayden orders the group to hide the death. Renewal and Decras continue watching them, with Decras delaying another planned threat until the conflict with Wizen is resolved.
recaps.in_short: Noah returns to Arbitage, perfects his runes with Sunder, and reaches rank four with Natural Disaster while Jalen's assassination campaign shifts into uneasy interest. Noah and Moxie bring their students into the advanced track and teach them to develop formations from deeply understood patterns. Meanwhile, Lee rebuilds her runes but fears the change required for a demon's advancement. Wizen infiltrates Arbitage through plant-controlled corpses, killing Will and using Mayreena as another puppet while holding Evergreen's essence. Silvertide destroys Wizen's local network and damages Evergreen, but Wizen survives. Inquisitor Raphael then exposes Lee and nearly kills Moxie. Lee advances to rank four to save her, and Azel manifests, kills Raphael, takes the fatal bloodline curse, and dies after temporarily restraining Lee's unstable rune. The group conceals Raphael's death as Wizen and a postponed divine test remain ahead.

recaps.text: Previously: Noah Vines has been living publicly as Vermil Linwick, the magus he killed after arriving in this world. At Arbitage, he teaches Todd, Isabel, and Emily while researching runes with Sunder, which allows him to divide combined runes and rebuild them. Moxie, his partner and fellow professor, was bound to the Torrin family until the death of Evergreen released her. Lee, their demon companion, has become part of the same close group. Their allies include the powerful Silvertide, while Azel remains tied to Lee and Noah's group. Karina, a Linwick shapeshifter once known as Bria, has a complicated history with Noah, and the Linwick and Torrin families remain dangerous powers around the group. Todd is recovering from a severe neck injury, Isabel hides a valuable inherited rune, and Emily does not yet know the full truth about her family or Noah's identity.

Noah, Moxie, and Lee finish their vacation by hunting monsters and gathering runes. Moxie claims Earthen Muster, a perfect Earth Master Rune, while Noah collects the ingredients needed to rebuild his rank-three foundation. Back at Arbitage, three visitors bring new obligations. Alexandra asks to become Noah's student after escaping Gentil's control. Contessa, formerly Evergreen's aide, needs shelter and becomes Noah's paid informant. Karina carries a summons from Jalen, the rank-six Linwick family head, who knows artifacts vanished from the family catacombs. Noah refuses to enter Linwick territory and demands neutral ground instead. Jalen responds by sending an assassin, but Karina kills the attacker before he reaches Noah. Noah meanwhile completes four focused rank-three runes - Sandstorm, Tsunami, Cyclone, and Earthquake. He returns to teaching with greater strength, but Jalen's demands have become an active campaign against him.

Noah reunites with Todd, Isabel, and Emily, admits Alexandra on probation, and temporarily includes James, a student of Revin. On Windscorn Plateau, each student defeats a monster alone. Alexandra reveals that permanent rank-three body runes give her exceptional durability and sword skill but prevent her from advancing further. Noah then offers the Earth Master Rune as the prize in a longer training competition. The first challenge is simply to touch Lee while she evades. The students divide into two groups and use hunted monsters as food bait, but Lee defeats both traps and nobody scores. Noah explains that all five could have cooperated and chosen together who most needed the prize. Back at Arbitage, he separates Todd, Isabel, and Emily from the others and secures their promises of secrecy before beginning private mind-meld sessions. Their lessons are about to move from ordinary training into Noah's most closely guarded rune knowledge.

In private mind-melds, Isabel reveals Soul, the inherited Master Rune that once drew deadly noble attention. Noah discloses Sunder's ability to separate combined runes and helps her create a perfect stone rune. Todd learns the same secret and replaces an overcomplicated concept with a perfect Steam rune. Emily's session forces broader truths into the open: Evergreen was her mother, Moxie had been held under Torrin control, and Noah killed both Evergreen and the original Vermil. Emily accepts Noah's truth-bound account and begins perfecting her own runes. Jalen's assassins continue to die, leading him to abandon disposable attackers in favor of a direct meeting. Seeking components for Noah and Lee, the group gains access to a masked noble auction. With about forty thousand gold and Sunder's ability to salvage flawed runes, Noah plans to turn unwanted purchases into useful materials. The auction opens under strict anonymity, giving the group room to bluff about its wealth and influence.

At the auction, Noah cultivates the appearance of wealth, buys powerful but flawed runes for later dismantling, and attracts Number 14, an anonymous bidder seeking rare monster runes. Number 14 trades a shadow-and-light rune lot suited to Lee, sixty-five thousand gold, and a future contact patch for Chitinus Spine Armor. Noah also acquires fire and ice runes needed for his own advancement. Garina and Ferdinand attend while searching for an unknown powerful target, and a later shared meal exposes their conflicting beliefs about power, fear, and care without producing a fight. Noah then uses Sunder to build flawless Volcano, Blizzard, and Thunderstorm runes. He combines seven perfect rank-three disasters into a rank-four Natural Disaster rune. At the same moment, Jalen arrives personally over the stolen Records of the Deceased. Noah's new domain resists the rank-six pressure better than anyone expected, but Jalen overwhelms the room and strikes him after Mascot's intervention turns the confrontation volatile.

Jalen transports Noah to the Linwick estate, but the threatened punishment becomes an unstable personal interest. He accepts that the undefended catacombs were a game Noah won, leaves the Records of the Deceased with him, and spends two hours playing darts before returning him unharmed. Noah confirms that Natural Disaster is genuinely perfect and discovers that his new domain senses nearby life while suppressing magic. He begins teaching the students that formations can grow from any thoroughly understood pattern, with Todd choosing fire, Isabel and Alexandra swordwork, Emily ice, and James music. Lee learns from Azel that demon advancement changes the demon rune itself and may alter her personality, but resolves to prepare for rank four so she can protect the group. Elsewhere, Ferdinand abandons his Church search rather than leave Garina. Renewal loses control of the red-horned cat avatar, while Decras joins her in watching the unknown mortal responsible. As Noah proves his rune's strength, Arbitage invites his group into its competitive advanced curriculum.

Noah discovers seven concealed rune positions in his violin and learns to cast two loaded effects at once through music. Silvertide confirms that the advanced track is real, prestigious, and likely to draw noble resentment toward Noah's students. Lee then asks Noah to rebuild her runes. They perfect her ordinary set, heal the resulting damage, and add a broken dark Master Rune without an immediate adverse effect. The advanced track tests Noah through Ulya's remote swordsman and accepts him after he destroys it. Todd, Isabel, Emily, Alexandra, and James also choose to join and begin demonstrating personal combat patterns. Gero privately tests Alexandra, whose nonmagical sword pattern cuts through his defenses. Will tests Moxie more aggressively and is forced to concede after she overwhelms him. In response, Noah creates a masked benefactor persona, defeats Will without killing him, and confronts Ulya. She disavows Will's coercion and agrees that future evaluations should follow ordinary limits, leaving Noah with both leverage and a possible channel into the advanced track.

Ulya discovers that Will is already dead and that a plant construct has been wearing his body. The construct attacks her and tries to prepare her as another replacement, but she escapes and brings Gero into the investigation. Wizen is revealed as the controller of several such bodies and the captor of Evergreen, whose runes he plans to consume. Ulya turns to Noah because his masked persona claimed knowledge of similar puppet magic. Noah connects the attack to Wizen's earlier use of Evergreen and joins the investigation, while the advanced track formally accepts his group. Seeking better intelligence, he visits Father at the Linwick estate. Father identifies Wizen as a powerful mind mage obsessed with the Torrins and explains that he can gradually prepare control over a person's body. By examining a puppet, Noah realizes replacement constructs should lack normal heartbeats and blood flow. Father promises to obstruct Wizen and send Brayden, but remains a self-interested ally. A second danger arrives as Raphael follows a blood trail into Arbitage while hunting a demon.

Noah quietly screens his students for heartbeats while continuing pattern lessons. Jalen follows the class to Windscorn Plateau, recognizes that their movements resemble formations, and agrees to investigate Wizen while keeping Noah's teaching from the noble families. At the advanced-track welcome gathering, Noah detects that leader Godric has no heartbeat and suspects another replacement. Using his masked Spider persona, he warns Ulya that one clone is present. Silvertide arrives after finding another plant-piloted corpse and publicly conceals what he knows. He later explains that Godric survives through an artificial heart and identifies Mayreena as the true puppet. Silvertide recruits Noah and Ulya to follow her. When cornered, Mayreena admits responsibility and deploys more wooden bodies. Silvertide then reveals his own silver-thread puppet, extends his domain through the surrounding network, and destroys Mayreena along with roughly twenty hidden puppets. The sympathetic strike reaches Evergreen's captive essence and shatters several of her runes. Wizen survives, but his local network is gone and he must change tactics.

With Wizen likely to retaliate, Noah and Moxie continue strengthening the students and preparing them for the advanced track's demanding standards. Raphael watches the group, suspects that one of Noah's associates is the demon he seeks, and forces Tim to send him to Windscorn Plateau. There he approaches Moxie, Lee, Emily, and Alexandra under the pretense of testing for possession. His rosary exposes Lee, while his rank-five blood domain suppresses Moxie and leaves her helpless. Lee turns back rather than escape and, at Azel's insistence, advances to rank four. Her new demon form breaks the immediate restraint and lets her stop Raphael's first attack, but he fires a bloodline curse at Moxie to exploit Lee's protective instinct. Lee takes the curse instead. Azel then manifests, kills Raphael, and draws the curse into himself. He admits that Lee's protective interpretation of Gluttony ruined his plan to claim her rune. Before dying from the curse, he restrains her unstable new rune and calls her his daughter.

After Raphael's death, Lee tells Moxie that Azel died protecting her. Emily accepts Lee immediately after learning she is a demon, while Alexandra remains wary but does not abandon her. Moxie buries Raphael and keeps his rosary. Brayden arrives in response to Tim's alarm, provides healing potions, judges that the Inquisitor probably acted alone, and instructs the group to conceal the death. Lee is now rank four, but fears that her new demon rune may eventually turn her against the people she advanced to protect. Azel's final intervention has only delayed that danger. Renewal and Decras observe the aftermath and believe Noah may be able to repair the flawed rune. They also confirm that Wizen remains a separate and immediate threat. His local puppet network has been destroyed and Evergreen's essence damaged, but he is still active. Decras postpones another planned test until Noah's group has dealt with Wizen, leaving the survivors stronger but facing both an unfinished mortal conflict and later divine interference.

characters.name: Silvertide

characters.name: Nair

characters.name: Renewal

characters.name: Decras

characters.name: Todd

characters.description: Noah's student and a sword fighter whose pattern builds pressure from strike to strike, resembling a gathering landslide.
characters.name: Isabel

characters.description: One of Noah's students, who returns safely after the attack on Moxie's group.
characters.name: Emily

characters.name: James

characters.description: Wizen's rank-five fire-mage operative, who battles Noah and Brayden beneath Arbitage's transport cannon.
characters.name: Barb

characters.name: Richard

characters.name: Ferdinand

characters.name: Garina

characters.name: Marley

characters.name: Masked stranger

characters.name: Local street lord's executioner

characters.name: Neighboring street lord's sister
