recaps.ending: Wizen keeps the Damned Plains key and escapes there with Barb after overwhelming the Arbitage assault. Noah, Moxie, and Lee are stranded in the same realm, but survive and enter a mobile city ruled by a rank-seven demon. Under the Spider identity, Noah captures a local gang, elevates a starving young demon into a rank-three knowledge demon, and begins absorbing neighboring territories. The proxy and his fear-feeding ally repel a challenge from the Silent Silver Tooth, but the faction's growth has drawn the attention of stronger city powers. Noah and Moxie remain committed to stabilizing Lee's dangerous merged rune while they seek Wizen, the key, and a route home. At Arbitage, Brayden and Jalen keep the students enrolled and training. Alexandra holds the Earth Master Rune, Todd continues his imbuement work, and Tim operates the damaged transport cannon under severe limits. No rescue path has been established, and Wizen's ultimate purpose remains unknown.
recaps.in_short: After Azel dies saving Lee, Noah and Moxie help her contain the unreadable rank-four rune formed from her demon power and broken Master Rune. Wizen's agents steal Arbitage's transport-cannon key, a portal artifact leading to the Damned Plains. While the enforcers search for Wizen, Noah repairs Tim's runes, guides his students' pattern training, creates the spatial-erasure rune Crumbling Space, and helps Moxie reach rank four. The assault on Wizen fails when he masters the key and overwhelms Arbitage's force. Noah, Moxie, and Lee follow him through a portal and become stranded in the Damned Plains. They enter a demon city in disguise, where Noah adopts the identity Spider, conquers a gang, and advances a starving young demon into a rank-three proxy. That proxy begins uniting local gangs and defeats a major challenger, attracting attention from greater powers. Brayden and Jalen keep Noah's students together at Arbitage while the trio searches for Wizen and a way home.

recaps.text: Previously: Noah Vines, publicly known as Vermil, teaches at Arbitage with Moxie and their demon companion Lee. His students include Todd, Isabel, Emily, and Alexandra. Noah possesses Sunder and has an unusual relationship with runes, while Azel has been linked to his soul. Moxie's history with the Torrin family continues to shape the dangers around their group. Wizen, a plant-and-mind mage, has already used controlled agents against them, and Brayden has been sent to interfere with his plans. The group begins this volume with Wizen still active and Lee facing enemies who hunt demons.

Azel's link to Noah vanishes as Moxie, Alexandra, and Emily return from a rank-five Inquisitor's attack. Lee returns separately, visibly exhausted and altered after advancing to rank four, and explains what happened. She advanced so she could resist Raphael's blood-magic domain. When Raphael aimed a bloodline curse at Moxie, Lee intercepted it and Azel took the effect. Before dying, Azel called Lee his daughter and bound her dangerous new rune. Noah later discovers that Lee's demon rune has fused with her broken Master Rune, creating an unreadable structure that exerts a compulsive pull when viewed. The binding appears stable, so the group chooses observation over immediate removal. Noah gives Silvertide evidence linking Wizen to plant and mind magic and a Torrin-related objective. Elsewhere, Revin diverts a rank-seven apostle sent toward Arbitage. Noah also begins repairing the transport operator Tim's defective runes with Sunder and Renewal's healing fragment. His students, meanwhile, approach the next stage of pattern training, with Emily needing extra help.

Noah begins teaching the students to channel magic through their practiced patterns. Emily starts forming magical housing through her snowstorm-like style, Alexandra learns how dangerous interruption can be, Isabel demonstrates strong control over her escalating sword pattern, and Todd develops pattern-based imbuements that Noah cannot directly suppress. James reveals that his laziness is a disguise and shows a light pattern that deflects attention. Moxie begins rethinking her own growth pattern as the full life cycle of a flower. The search for Wizen's objective leads beneath Arbitage's transport cannon, where Noah finds Brayden fighting Barb, a rank-five fire mage. Noah's Sunder formation severs Barb's arm, but she escapes with the cannon's Torrin-donated power source. Brayden identifies it as a long-distance portal key to the Damned Plains. The cannon operator survives, while Barb's hidden healer dies in the destruction. Wizen now possesses the artifact and Arbitage loses ordinary access to its transport system.

Wizen takes the stolen key and prepares to collect four other items needed for his plan. Arbitage conceals the transport cannon's failure while its enforcers investigate Wizen's remaining voluntary agents. Brayden explains the difficulty of space runes and confirms that he knows Noah is not the original owner of Vermil's body. Noah and Moxie infer that Arbitage doubles as an artifact storehouse for noble families, though they cannot prove it. They refocus on their students and the advanced track. Todd demonstrates combat imbuements that recycle some energy from motion and explosions, while Lee's restrained rune remains stable but unsafe for heavy use. Noah removes a spare space rune from Lee to begin his own research. Moxie assembles plant and earth concepts for her future rank-four rune. Seeking rarer materials, Noah decides to find the collector who bought Violet Transference. Ulya then arrives to bring Noah and Moxie into the advanced track's political contest.

Verud warns Noah that Torrin-connected figures intend to force Emily out of Arbitage. Noah suspects the warning is part of a wider contest involving Verud, Jacob, and possible interest in Isabel's Master Rune. Ulya becomes a provisional informant, and Noah's group stages a disruptive advanced-track appearance to keep hostile students away from Emily and Isabel. Noah defeats Marley in a no-magic duel, while Alexandra wins first blood against Jacob's more composed sword fighter. Lee turns another challenge into an eating contest and wins. Silvertide identifies Otto, a rank-six King-family rune collector, as the buyer of Violet Transference. Noah trades Otto a monster rune for rank-two space and matter runes plus one hour in a restricted hunting ground. Bird, Otto's masked assistant, completes the exchange and guides Noah to the site. Karina and Contessa are living in Noah's nominal dorm room and caring for his companion. Noah enters the dangerous space-monster habitat under a strict recall limit.

Noah uses Sunder to draw a mass of space monsters and secretly harvests far more runes than Otto's catch paper can explain. A giant teleporting creature kills him, but his body returns and the transport cannon recalls him. His grimoire retains a large hidden collection of space runes. Conventional teleportation proves beyond his current understanding, so Noah builds on his personal experience of the void instead. He sunders several strong space runes into raw energy, opens an existing soul wound as a catalyst, and forms the rank-four rune Crumbling Space. Its first test erases part of a wall, but drains the rune and works only at very short range. At an enforcer meeting, Noah shares what he knows of Wizen and the Damned Plains key, prompting an active search. Brayden visits the students and joins Noah's commitment to stop Wizen. In the class competition, Isabel and Alexandra demonstrate equal but contrasting strength as the final evaluation begins.

The students voluntarily leave Alexandra as the winner of the Earth Master Rune, recognizing her effort and need. She accepts it but delays testing it. Noah continues repairing Tim's soul, and the Linwick family head notices Tim's improvement without discovering Sunder. Tim grants Noah access to the Bleached River, where Noah gathers energy and confirms that Crumbling Space remains limited to the area immediately around him. Moxie then combines seven flawless runes into a rank-four rune expressing flowers, growth, death, and renewal. She gains a domain and begins exploring the rune's ability to turn organic matter into flowers. Noah reassures Lee that her own power is not lesser, though its effect on her identity remains a danger. Ulya receives Earth runes to rebuild her puppets and continues reporting on the advanced track. The school conflict is interrupted when Silvertide announces that Wizen has been found using the key in a ritual. Noah, Moxie, and Lee join the force preparing to breach his sanctum.

Before departing, Noah completes Tim's final planned rune repair. The Arbitage assault enters Wizen's underground sanctum by a one-way transport jump. Godric divides the force, while Silvertide leads Noah, Moxie, and Lee toward the key. Wizen has already killed many enforcers and embedded the artifact in his dagger. He defeats Godric, Silvertide, Brayden, and the others with several kinds of magic and the key's spatial power. Noah wounds him with a Sunder formation, but Wizen recognizes Noah's use of Weave and suppresses the group. When Wizen opens a portal, Lee knocks him through, and Noah and Moxie refuse to release her. All three are pulled into the Damned Plains. They survive, disguise themselves as demons, gather sacrifices, and gain entry to a city carried by an enormous walking creature and ruled by a rank-seven demon. With no route home, they decide to build influence. Noah begins distributing food and performing behind a mask to create the appearance of a powerful hidden faction.

The masked figure called Spider protects a starving group from a gang enforcer, then forces two young demons to guide him to their street lord. He defeats the gang, kills its leader, bans the extraction of food from residents, and appoints one of the starving youths as his acting ruler. Spider is Noah's new identity, supported by the disguised Moxie and Lee. Noah rapidly advances his proxy from rank one to rank three, stopping before the more dangerous identity changes associated with rank four. Lee secures a neighboring gang after killing its leader and coercing his sister into a false succession story. The young street lord proves his new strength, accepts the neighboring leader's submission on lenient terms, and discovers that his demon nature feeds on knowledge. He makes the experienced leader his second-in-command. Violet, his closest companion, asks Noah to advance her as well so she can protect him. Noah agrees, and Violet offers to guide him to an apothecary for the needed potions.

At Arbitage, Todd, Isabel, Emily, Alexandra, and James train together against Jalen. Jalen recruits Bird to support them with family resources while keeping her private research concealed. In the demon city, Noah's Spider reputation spreads as he prepares Violet's advancement. His young proxy allies with a rank-three demon who feeds on fear and learns to set limits on their mutual energy exchange. When the Silent Silver Tooth sends a rank-three representative to assess the new faction, the proxy turns the negotiation into a truthful question game. Each answer gives the knowledge demon more energy, while his fear-feeding ally controls the emotional contest. The representative kills her own guards to restore herself but still cannot recover the advantage, and she flees in fear. The proxy then commits surplus food to hungry outsiders and resolves to change the city's existing power structure. A hidden observer reports Spider's expansion to a powerful mistress, who expects the city's ruler to respond but orders continued surveillance. Noah, Moxie, and Lee remain stranded, Wizen still has the key, and Spider's growing faction has attracted stronger attention.

characters.description: The masked leader behind a growing street faction in the Damned Plains. Spider repairs Violet's advancement, entrusts her and a young demon leader with uniting nearby gangs, and prepares them for resistance from stronger powers.
characters.name: Spider

characters.description: A newly advanced rank-three demon whose strength and identity center on protecting the people she regards as family. Spider repairs her failed rune combination and appoints her as a defender of his emerging faction.
characters.name: Violet

characters.description: A young demon whom Spider charges with bringing local gangs under one banner. He shares responsibility with Violet for consolidating the surrounding gangs, protecting their group, and preparing for stronger opposition.
characters.name: Spider's Street-Lord Proxy

characters.description: A shadow-wielding killer who becomes the young street-lord proxy's second-in-command. Her private arrangement with him cannot be readily replaced, giving their alliance a foundation beyond ordinary gang loyalty.
characters.name: The Proxy's Assassin Ally

characters.description: The man operating as Spider while stranded in the Damned Plains. He is building a demon power base, collecting runes, and studying the way demon runes shape their bearers in the hope of repairing Lee's unstable condition.
characters.name: Noah Vines

characters.description: Noah's demon companion, a capable protector, and the focus of his rune research. Her fused Master Rune and demon rune break familiar rules, leaving Noah determined to preserve both her power and her sense of self.
characters.name: Lee

characters.description: A horned, teleporting cat capable of crossing into the Damned Plains. Its arrival offers Noah's stranded group a possible way to send word to their allies, although it does not provide them with a route home.
characters.name: Mascot

characters.description: A human intruder who establishes a foothold in the Damned Plains with Barb. His overwhelming mind magic turns captives into compliant informants as he searches for Sievan, a demon lord said to have returned from the afterlife.
characters.name: Wizen

characters.description: Wizen's associate in the Damned Plains. She remains with him as he establishes a base and begins pursuing his objective there.
characters.name: Barb

characters.description: A demon lord reputed to have crossed the afterlife and returned. Wizen begins hunting him soon after entering the Damned Plains, making Sievan central to a purpose Wizen has not yet disclosed and will pursue through force.
characters.name: Sievan

characters.description: A deity observing Noah's group with Decras. Renewal follows Noah's study of demon runes and considers whether Lee's unusual condition shows that their flaws might be repairable.
characters.name: Renewal

characters.description: A deity observing Noah's group with Renewal. Decras regards demons as failed experiments but acknowledges that Lee is exceptional, and he is concerned that Noah and Wizen may clash over a Master Rune.
characters.name: Decras

characters.description: Noah's rank-four partner and a principal defender of Spider's camp. She captures hired killers with powerful vine magic and takes responsibility for stopping threats before they can expose the faction or endanger its residents.
characters.name: Moxie

characters.description: The identity used to summon Spider to a private mansion. A masked figure occupies Pirren's throne during the deceptive meeting, but Spider detects the false display of power and kills the figure after a demand for submission.
characters.name: Pirren

characters.description: The ruler identified as the dominant power in the walking demon city. His position defines the political order Spider is entering and the authority surrounding its elite auctions, even before he takes direct notice of the Web.
characters.name: Belkus

characters.description: A covert seeker directing a search for an undisclosed target in an original Linwick crypt. Father orders Janice to report as soon as she locates the crypt and not to enter it herself.
characters.name: Father

characters.description: Father's researcher, charged with locating an original Linwick crypt without entering it. She traces a deliberately erased period in the family records and expects the search to reach its objective soon.
characters.name: Janice

characters.description: A rank-six Linwick family head who oversees Vermil's students during their teacher's absence. He recognizes that their improvised formation work is far ahead of conventional training and receives proof that Vermil is alive.
characters.name: Jalen

characters.description: Vermil's half-brother and one of the temporary guardians supervising the students. He works alongside Jalen during their improvised formation practice and is present when Mascot confirms that Vermil survived in the Damned Plains.
characters.name: Brayden

characters.description: The servant of an unnamed mistress who approaches Pirren with an offer of access to the next auction. He knows about Pirren's private task for Spider and leads her toward the only route he claims will succeed.
characters.name: Taleel

characters.description: A rank-five demon whom Pirren identifies as serving no man. At this point, the reason Pirren mentions Yoku while discussing Spider's independence remains unresolved.
characters.name: Yoku

characters.description: A King-family rune researcher connected to Otto. Jalen pressures her to provide two runes for each of Vermil's students, and she bargains for instruction in the shieldless combat method she has been extending through her own research.
characters.name: Bird

characters.description: A combat instructor helping Vermil's students while their usual teachers are absent. He works directly with Alexandra on sword technique and joins the wider group preparing the students for an approaching examination.
characters.name: Silvertide

characters.description: One of Vermil's students preparing for an examination under temporary instructors. She cannot safely accept new runes, so Silvertide continues developing her sword work while the group arranges other forms of practical support.
characters.name: Alexandra

characters.description: An unannounced masked, silver-haired demon waiting in Pirren's auction booth. She recognizes Spider on sight and is associated with the unexplained arrangement that secured Pirren's access to the auction.
characters.name: Masked Auction Stranger

characters.description: The masked silver-haired demon who joins Spider's auction booth and permits him to call her Yoru. She is Yoku, the Rising Moon, and she quietly tests possible futures involving Spider while concealing her full intentions.
characters.name: Yoru

characters.description: A rank-five gluttony demon who competes for Bleeding Blades at the auction. He physically clashes with Matis during the bidding, is injured, and loses the lot after Matis intimidates the other bidders.
characters.name: Feebog

characters.description: A rank-five slaughter demon who intimidates other auction bidders and competes directly with Spider for a rune Spider wants as material for Lee's reconstruction.
characters.name: Matis

characters.description: A rank-five auction attendee whom Pirren knows and fears. Her presence places another powerful bidder near Spider as he begins openly competing for valuable runes.
characters.name: Sinclaire

characters.description: One of Vermil's students training under Jalen and Silvertide during his absence. Isabel becomes interested in learning to fight without ordinary sight while the group works toward the domain-based perception expected at rank four.
characters.name: Isabel

characters.description: An organizer within the Web who manages the camp's practical needs and gathers intelligence. Vrith identifies Igris as the likely source of the attacks directed at Spider and the young knowledge demon.
characters.name: Vrith

characters.description: A rank-five wealth demon affiliated with Belkus. Intelligence gathered by the Web points to him as the likely sponsor of attacks on Spider's camp and its young knowledge demon leader, prompting Noah to plan a direct confrontation.
characters.name: Igris

characters.description: An axe-wielding rank-five demon acting on Sievan's orders. She tracks Spider to recover a death-associated Master Rune, observes his operation against Igris, and treats lethal combat as an object of intense fascination.
characters.name: Axil

characters.description: Belkus's commander, sent to bring Spider to an audience after Sievan's interest changes the political stakes. His task is diplomatic, but it carries the authority of the city's ruler and follows Belkus's abrupt cancellation of earlier hostilities.
characters.name: Zorin

characters.description: Sievan's authorized representative, whom Axil offers to introduce to Noah. The harbinger can negotiate on Sievan's behalf over the death-associated Master Rune Noah holds.
characters.name: Sievan's Harbinger

characters.description: A weak local child who knows the City of Gold's dens. An artifact occupies the place of her heart, and Wizen spares her after she exposes false directions and agrees to guide him.
characters.name: Young Demon Girl

characters.description: A death-rune user who serves Sievan. He presents Noah and Belkus with a shadow record of Wizen's challenge in the City of Gold and treats direct death magic there as dangerously destructive.
characters.name: Zath

characters.description: One of Vermil's students, continuing intensive formation and combat practice during his absence. Todd uses stone protection on his limbs and bracelet-fired magic while adapting to close-range opponents.
characters.name: Todd

characters.description: One of Vermil's students, still training at Arbitage under Jalen, Brayden, Silvertide, and a masked combat instructor. James takes a support position when the group is assigned a dangerous live-monster formation exercise.
characters.name: James

characters.description: One of Vermil's students, continuing formation and combat work while her teacher remains in the Damned Plains. Emily serves in a support position during the group's escalating live-monster exercise under its temporary guardians.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: Wizen's dead daughter. He seeks Sievan in the belief that the demon lord can open a path to the afterlife and allow him to retrieve her.
characters.name: Bella

characters.description: The young guide traveling with Wizen is Hollow, unable to form or bind even a demon rune because her soul is improperly formed. Sievan can delay her death with death energy, but does not expect her to survive the day.
characters.name: Hollow Demon Girl

recaps.ending: Sievan brings Noah and Wizen together because both carry power connected to Decras, then asks Noah to help him die as a final attempt to escape the limits built into demon-kind. Wizen wounds Sievan and enters the line through the portal Sievan opens, still determined to retrieve Bella from the afterlife. Empty Proliferation protects Noah from Wizen's command. Noah follows Wizen into the line after failing to save the Hollow girl, whose lack of a demon rune had briefly offered a new lead toward curing demons. Zath evacuates Moxie and Lee, leaving them alive but separated from Noah. Lee still has no safe way to create her own Fragment of Self, and Sievan's fate remains unsettled. Yoru and the Web remain in the Damned Plains, where Spider's faction has survived Belkus's opposition and become a significant local power. At Arbitage, Jalen, Brayden, Bird, and Silvertide continue preparing Vermil's students through improvised formations and live-monster exercises. The unresolved grimoire entity, Wizen's pursuit of Bella, and Noah's route back to his companions all carry forward.
recaps.in_short: Stranded in the Damned Plains, Noah builds the Web under his Spider identity while researching a cure for Lee. His auction victories draw Yoru, Belkus, and Sievan's agents into his orbit. A lethal experiment produces Warped Matter and reveals the Fragment of Self, while an examination of Igris shows that every demon rune shares a flawed external origin. Noah proposes that Lee create a personal fragment, but no safe catalyst is found. After Noah kills Axil with Sunder and dies himself, Sievan restores her only partly. Belkus trades Noah mind runes for leaving the city, enabling Noah to create Empty Proliferation against Wizen's control. Wizen reaches Sievan to reclaim his dead daughter Bella. Sievan reveals that demons are bound by their rune nature and asks Noah to help him die. Wizen enters the line through Sievan's portal, and Noah follows after the Hollow girl dies despite his healing attempt. Moxie and Lee survive but are evacuated away from him.

recaps.text: Previously: Noah Vines lives under the inherited identity Vermil and teaches Todd, Isabel, Alexandra, James, and Emily at Arbitage. Moxie and Lee are his closest companions, while Brayden is his half-brother and Silvertide has helped train the students. Noah possesses Sunder and has repeatedly survived death through an unusual means of returning to a body. Lee's demon nature and unstable fused runes place her identity and future at risk. Wizen is a powerful enemy whose mind magic and wider plans threaten Noah's group. By the start of this volume, Noah, Moxie, and Lee are separated from their allies in the Damned Plains, where they seek a way to protect Lee and return to the mortal plane.

Spider advances Violet to rank three and appoints her to protect a young knowledge demon who will unite the local gangs. The young leader can taste truth but struggles to control an energy-draining form of feeding, while his shadow-wielding second-in-command serves under a private arrangement. Spider is Noah Vines, and the faction is part of his larger attempt to gather resources in the Damned Plains. Studying these demons may also help him understand Lee's fused and unstable runes. Mascot crosses into the plane, giving Noah, Moxie, and Lee a chance to send a message home, though not a means to leave. They report that they are alive and ask about their students. The newly consolidated street faction adopts the name the Web and prepares for retaliation. Elsewhere, Wizen and Barb establish their own base. Wizen uses mind control to question a captive about Sievan, a demon lord rumored to have returned from the afterlife.

The Web survives an assassination attempt when Moxie and Lee eliminate the attackers. Noah gathers a large stock of low-rank runes, then follows a captured scout to a meeting staged under Pirren's identity. He kills the false figure, forces the real Pirren to negotiate, and secures her help entering an auction. Pirren names Belkus as the ruler of the walking city and mentions Yoku, whose significance remains unclear. Noah's faction is now visible to stronger political interests, while Wizen continues searching separately for Sievan. At Arbitage, Jalen and Brayden supervise Vermil's students as they develop improvised formations. Mascot delivers Noah's letter, providing direct proof that Vermil is alive in the Damned Plains. The message reassures the students and their temporary guardians, but offers no route for reuniting the two groups. A separate Linwick crypt search is also nearing its objective, though its target has not been disclosed.

The Web absorbs the local street lords after Lee destroys a gang that attacked its vulnerable members. Ten gangs now follow Spider, but rapid expansion brings both internal strain and organized retaliation. Pirren's attempt to arrange auction access leads her to Yoku, the Rising Moon, whose future-weighing power detects unusual consequences around Spider's protection. Meanwhile, Bird and Silvertide join Jalen and Brayden in supporting Vermil's students. Bird trades rune assistance for knowledge of their shieldless fighting method, while Alexandra continues training without taking new runes. At the auction, a masked silver-haired demon introduces herself as Yoru and is confirmed to be Yoku. She prepares a poisoned drink as a test, but every likely future in which Spider or his companions consume it ends in her death. Unable to explain why Spider creates such dangerous outcomes, Yoru abandons the poison and changes her objective from controlling him to securing an alliance. The auction then begins with Noah seeking material for Lee's runes and his own advancement.

Noah turns the auction into a public demonstration of Spider's power. He kills Matis, defeats Sinclaire, acquires useful matter runes, and buys the broken death-associated Master Rune Deathly Night. The purchase may attract Sievan, who normally claims valuable death runes. Yoru buys an additional Unstable Mass rune as a gift for Noah and reveals through her choices that her future sight cannot reliably resolve him. Her Master Rune, Moonlit Prophecy, normally destroys the minds of those who meet her gaze, but it collapses when used on Spider. The encounter leaves her convinced that she cannot place him under her control and must instead become part of his plans. Noah still does not understand her full purpose, but his auction victories greatly increase Spider's wealth and reputation. His immediate gains support two linked goals: building enough power to oppose Wizen and finding a way to reconstruct Lee's dangerous runes without destroying who she is.

Yoru joins the Web's camp after her failed attempt to read Spider's future. Noah enforces a rule that she cannot take from weaker camp members, and Violet cautiously shares a tent with her. Yoru can predict likely words and actions so precisely that it resembles mind reading, but she has little understanding of friendship, love, failure, or mutual loyalty. Violet tries to teach her that people cannot be treated solely as tools, while Yoru admits that no future in which she opposes Spider ends in victory. Her deeper aim is freedom from anyone else's control, and Noah advises her that genuine desires must be discovered through experience rather than copied. At Arbitage, Isabel becomes interested in fighting without sight as the students continue demanding combat exercises under Jalen and Silvertide. In the Damned Plains, the Web remains wary of Yoru, but she stays with the faction and begins questioning a life governed entirely by survival and prediction.

Noah attempts to forge a new matter rune by combining two auction purchases with power copied from Crumbling Space. He uses his own death and bodily reconstruction as the catalyst, badly cracking his soul in the process. The experiment unexpectedly creates two conjoined structures: Warped Matter and a Fragment of Self. A temporary duplicate within his mind helps him recognize that the fragment is not an ordinary rune, but the connection joining his body, soul, desires, and magic. Reintegrating it gives Noah far finer control over his body and frees Warped Matter, whose branching effect consumes nearby material until its limited charge runs out. The resemblance between Noah's discovery and Lee's bound demon runes offers a promising direction, but Noah refuses to repeat the dangerous method on her. Lee's seal remains stable for a limited time under restrained use. As Noah prepares to study hostile demons directly, Sievan orders an unnamed subordinate to retrieve a particular rune, bringing a greater power's attention toward Spider.

Wizen infiltrates the City of Gold with Barb and begins gathering information about Sievan. In the walking city, Noah and Moxie attack Igris, the rank-five wealth demon believed to have funded assaults on the Web. Moxie's new flowering vine consumes energy throughout the mansion while Noah forces a mind-meld with Igris. Inside the demon's soul, Noah discovers that different demon runes all reduce to the same foreign rank-one foundation. Igris dies from the damage, but the discovery shows that Lee's problem is not unique. Every demon appears to carry an imitation derived from the same outside being. Noah proposes replacing that dependence by helping Lee create her own Fragment of Self. She needs intent, power, and a deeply personal catalyst, but the group cannot identify a safe catalyst and Noah refuses self-mutilation as a method. Their new theory gives Lee a direction without yet providing a cure. At the same time, Axil begins hunting Spider on Sievan's behalf for the death-associated Master Rune.

Belkus sends four rank-five enforcers to execute Spider for Igris's death, but Axil kills them and demands a fight of her own. Her extreme regeneration defeats Noah's conventional attacks, so he uses Sunder. The strike kills both of them. Noah returns to life with his magic temporarily sealed, while Sievan intercepts Axil after death and restores her at a steep cost. Sunder has left only part of her body, strength, and runes intact. Noah refuses her demand for Deathly Night and reframes the dispute as a negotiation between Spider and Sievan. The public deaths and returns elevate Spider's reputation and force Belkus to reconsider direct hostility. Instead of launching another assault, Belkus has Zorin, his commander, request Spider's presence. Noah faces a diminished Axil, lacks access to his magic for several more hours, and needs leverage against both demon lords while the search for Lee's personal Fragment of Self remains stalled.

Axil identifies Noah's grimoire as a living abomination made from fused demon bodies and damaged souls. Her fear gives Noah bargaining leverage, but a hidden presence associated with the book threatens her into silence. Sievan's unnamed harbinger arrives to negotiate as Zorin escorts Noah, Yoru, and the others to Belkus. In the audience, Belkus recognizes Yoru as Yoku, the Rising Moon, and accuses her of manipulating people to seize his city. Yoru leaves with Mascot after securing the future she wants. Noah then reveals that the Web's information network exists to find Wizen and that he is a teacher rather than a would-be ruler. Belkus recognizes Wizen's name, creating a possible route to the enemy Noah has been seeking. The meeting also clarifies the balance around Spider: Belkus wants him removed from Yoru's influence, Sievan wants his rune, and Yoru regards joining his side as her only viable future.

Belkus and Zath confirm that Wizen is in the City of Gold, where he is killing powerful demons and openly challenging Sievan. Noah agrees to leave Belkus's city and not support Yoru against him, receiving several mind runes in return. He dismantles them with Sunder and refuses concepts based on domination or direct mental harm. Drawing on the purposeless repetition he endured on the line, he constructs Empty Proliferation, a flawless rank-four mind rune intended to resist Wizen and perhaps disrupt his control over others. Zath waits to take Noah, Moxie, and Lee to Sievan while conversing with an invisible sapient presence that may be tied to the grimoire. At Arbitage, Todd, Isabel, Alexandra, James, and Emily continue training under Jalen, Brayden, Silvertide, and another combat instructor, progressing to live-monster formation work. Both groups are preparing for confrontations: the students for their examination, and Noah for an enemy who can overwhelm demon lords.

Wizen reaches Sievan's domain with a young demon guide whose failing soul cannot hold runes. He protects her during the ascent and finally reveals his purpose: his daughter Bella is dead, and he believes Sievan can open a route to the afterlife so he can reclaim her. When Sievan refuses, Wizen draws on the key and several bound powers to attack. Zath portals Noah, Moxie, and Lee into the confrontation. Renewal and Decras observe that Sievan deliberately allowed Wizen through so the two intruders would meet. Decras reveals that he created Sievan, the first demon, from part of his own runes. Even with seven perfected rank-eight runes, Sievan cannot advance beyond the nature imposed on him. He explains privately to Noah that demons literally are their flawed runes and will eventually be consumed by them. The young guide is Hollow, with no rune tether at all, and is dying. Sievan admits that he too is dying and asks Noah to help him die, hoping death might offer a final path beyond his limits.

Noah recognizes that Wizen's defining rune is Weave, not Sunder. It combines powers taken or bound from other mages, explaining the range of magic Wizen can wield. Noah orders Zath to evacuate Moxie and Lee, separating himself from them as Wizen continues attacking Sievan. The Hollow girl confirms that both Wizen and Noah want Sievan dead. Because she has no demon rune, Noah briefly sees her as a possible unaltered baseline who might reveal how to free Lee and demon-kind from rune compulsion. Wizen wounds Sievan and tries to command Noah, but Empty Proliferation prevents the order from taking hold. Sievan opens a portal to the line, giving Wizen the route he needs to pursue Bella in the afterlife. Noah attempts to save the Hollow girl with Renewal's fragment, but she dies before he can learn from her. Wizen enters the portal, and Noah follows him. Moxie and Lee survive with Zath, while Lee's cure, Sievan's desired death, the grimoire's hidden entity, and Noah's return route all remain unresolved.
